senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גָּנַן)shield, defense. Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 70ᵃ; 70ᵇ (ref. to ואל מצנים, Job V, 5) לא בזיין ולא במ׳ not with weapon or with shield (will he prevail); Lev. R. s. 28; Pesik. R. s. 18; Yalk. Job 898.—
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> end (ref. to <he>אלף המגן</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">ib.</cite>) <he>אלף דור … אותו המ׳</he> I folded together (skipped over) a thousand generations and brought unto them that shield (the Torah).—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:19">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00426"><he>גּוּן</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מָגִנִּים</he>, <he>מָגִינִּים</he>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 22:5">Is. XXII, 5</cite>) <he>שהיו מקרקרים … עושין אותן מ׳</he> they broke down the walls of their houses and made of them defenses. Cant. R. l. c. <he>לבניך אני נעשה מ׳ הרבה</he> unto thy children I shall be many defenses.

Gen. R. s. 44 מ׳ של צדיקים shields of the righteous (protectors of their generation by dint of their righteousness); a. e.—Esp. Magen, the first section of the Prayer of Benedictions closing with מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם (usu. called אָבוֹת, v. אָב).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:1">Deut. R. s. 11</cite>, beg. <he>חוזר לתחלת מ׳</he> (<cite ref="Berakhot 34a:6">Ber. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>לראש</he>) he must go back to the beginning of the first section.

<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:5">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00314"><he>פּוּק</he></cite> h.—<he>בֵּית הַמָּגִינִּין</he>, <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 4:7">Tosef. Kil. IV, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00160"><he>מְגִינָּא</he></cite>.
